83e904e2ab289c57b516bb316263b95c523db7b8.pinyin: tā bù gāi duì bié rén de cái chǎn bào yǒu fēi fèn zhī xiǎng.
83e904e2ab289c57b516bb316263b95c523db7b8.text: 他不该对别人的财产抱有非分之想。

83eb55f8d437ab3e5fc5e1258eafa5974a563b1c.pinyin: dòu zi jīng jìn pào hòu biàn de bǎo mǎn.
83eb55f8d437ab3e5fc5e1258eafa5974a563b1c.text: 豆子经浸泡后变得饱满。

83edba43e92e76cdc582ab0ac9ae2a761da9e409.pinyin: chuáng shàng de cǎo rù hěn hòu.

83ee34c114e51e1bf4aa8ac65475927dd76cfd49.pinyin: shěn shen zuò le yì guō rè tāng.

83fb87041316839e12adc096663e8f8d76583439.pinyin: tā de yǎn jì kān bǐ zhuān yè rén shì.
83fb87041316839e12adc096663e8f8d76583439.text: 她的演技堪比专业人士。

83fe977b9f021c080b5f98304d445bb2d02d6a0b.pinyin: zhè běn shū jiè shào dǎi zú de jié rì.
83fe977b9f021c080b5f98304d445bb2d02d6a0b.text: 这本书介绍傣族的节日。

83ff8e9f564c6c40a4c6a05bb4e3dca057b3bf36.pinyin: qián tái kě yǐ dài tì zhù kè shōu jiàn.
83ff8e9f564c6c40a4c6a05bb4e3dca057b3bf36.text: 前台可以代替住客收件。
